user_query: I am looking for auto parts for my vehicle. Could you please assist me in finding the best deals? Also, can you search for the availability and prices of iPad on eBay and provide me with the results? Thank you.

TaskList.description: Search for available auto parts for the user's vehicle and compare prices from different suppliers.
Retrieve the best deals on auto parts based on the search results from Step 1.
Search for the availability and prices of iPads on eBay.
Compile the results of the iPad search and summarize the findings.
Provide a summary of the best deals for auto parts and iPad availability to the user.
